content:
samir: Heads up — rooftop mini-gym at 12:00 today? Quick calisthenics circuit + foam rolling. 20m total.
ellie: I'm in. Can I bring a speaker? :headphones:
dan: works for me. can we slot a kettlebell station?
samir: we have one 8kg KB in the storage closet but no guarantee on straps. anyone else?
kia: i can swing by with my 12kg at 11:45 if that's helpful.
courtney: love this. adding a short mobility block too — saved my back last week :) :raised_hands:
ops-bot: Reminder: rooftop max occupancy is 12. Please RSVP by 11:30 or we’ll move to the conference room.
ellie: poll — what station order do we want?
samir: poll options — 1) KB swings 2) wall-sits & lunges 3) mobility + rolling. React with 1/2/3.
dan: 1 :one: (KB swings)
kia: 3 :three: (mobility)
courtney: 2 :two: (wall-sits)
ellie: 3 :three: — mobility wins for me
samir: ok mobility first, KB second, bodyweight circuit last.

samir: quick plan (20m):
```
12:00-12:05 mobility + banded shoulders
12:05-12:12 kettlebell station (AMRAP partner swaps)
12:12-12:19 circuit: 3 rounds 45s on / 15s off (pushups, step-ups, plank-to-pike)
12:19-12:20 collective foam roll cooldown
```

ellie: also can we borrow extra mats? ops said only 6 in storage. i can bring 2 from home.
kia: bringing a mat and a small towel.
dan: heads-up — bring closed-toe shoes for the KB station. last time a shoe flew off :sweat_smile:
courtney: shoutout to @samir for organizing these little bursts, they're my energy reset. :sparkles:
samir: aw thanks! if anyone wants me to add this to the recurring lunchtime calendar invite, say so.
ellie: yes pls add weekly on Tue/Thu for the month?
samir: will do — tentative Tue/Thu 12:00 for April.
ops-bot: FYI — rooftop permit request submitted for recurring use. awaiting facilities approval.
dan: quick Q: parking for 12:00 — is the delivery bay ok for 10 min drop-off (KB)?
ops-bot: Delivery bay allowed for unloading only; please move vehicle after 5 minutes to avoid ticketing.
kia: I'll park and run the KB up. hero points if i don't faceplant the stairs.
courtney: gif: https://giphy.com/gifs/workout-1rXbK3n7r5eXQ (posted)
ellie: perfect. see y'all at noon. if facilities nixes rooftop, fallback is conf room B.
samir: last call — 11:20 final RSVP?
dante: (oops wrong account)
dan: present! :muscle:
samir: good stuff, see you then.
